question: What will be the average daily mean temperature in New York over the 7 days ending October 19, 2026, in degrees Celsius?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the mean of the daily mean 2-metre air temperatures from 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-19 at latitude 40.71, longitude -74.01 (New York), from the ERA5 reanalysis as served by the Open-Meteo historical weather API (archive-api.open-meteo.com), in degrees Celsius.
research:
I found no forecast that covers October 13-19, 2026. It is 22 to 28 days out, and nothing before resolution settles it. The historical baseline is about 13.5°C (range 11.0 to 16.8°C), with a modest seasonal lean toward warm.

## 1. Resolution source
- The source is the Open-Meteo ERA5 archive, daily `temperature_2m_mean` at 40.71, -74.01. I queried it directly.
- 2026-09-21: Latest value 18.8°C. Values for Sep 1-21, 2026 ranged from 17.4°C (Sep 15) to 26.2°C (Sep 10), with no gaps. Sep 19 was 20.1°C and Sep 20 was 19.1°C. [Open-Meteo archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=40.71&longitude=-74.01&start_date=2026-09-01&end_date=2026-09-21&daily=temperature_2m_mean)
- Caveat: the question does not give a timezone. I pulled the past-year data below using America/New_York. The API default is GMT, which can shift daily means slightly, usually by a few tenths of a degree.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened yet that settles or nearly settles the question. The window is 22 to 28 days away, beyond reliable deterministic forecast range.

## 3. Recent news
- 2026-09-17: CPC's long-lead outlook has the Northeast "leaning above-normal" for temperature in October-December 2026 (via an Almanac summary). That page gave no October-only map value for New York. [homealmanac.us](https://homealmanac.us/outlook/northeast/)
- 2026-09-16: The weekly Niño 3.4 index reached about +3.0°C, a very strong El Niño. IRI says it could rank among the strongest on record. [IRI](https://iri.columbia.edu/?p=31779)
- 2026-09-10: CPC ENSO discussion: El Niño Advisory in effect. The August discussion gave a >90% chance of a very strong event in fall/winter 2026-27. [CPC Sep 2026](https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/analysis_monitoring/enso_disc_sep2026/ensodisc.shtml), [CPC Aug 2026](https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/analysis_monitoring/enso_disc_aug2026/ensodisc.shtml)
- Background: El Niño's effect on Northeast temperatures in mid-October is weak. Most of its US influence shows up in winter.

## 4. Base rates
These are 7-day means for Oct 13-19 from the same Open-Meteo ERA5 point, using America/New_York days:

| Year | Mean (°C) |
|---|---|
| 2015 | 11.0 |
| 2016 | 16.5 |
| 2017 | 15.4 |
| 2018 | 11.1 |
| 2019 | 13.2 |
| 2020 | 13.9 |
| 2021 | 16.8 |
| 2022 | 13.1 |
| 2023 | 12.0 |
| 2024 | 12.1 |
| 2025 | 13.3 |

- 2015-2025 summary: mean about 13.5°C, median 13.2°C, standard deviation about 2.0°C, range 11.0 to 16.8°C. [Open-Meteo archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=40.71&longitude=-74.01&start_date=2017-10-13&end_date=2017-10-19&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=America/New_York)
- Within the window, single days ranged from 5.5°C to 22.0°C. Big swings happen because of frontal passages, for example 2015 dropped from 16.7 to 5.5, and 2016 rose from 11.8 to 22.0.
- Climatology is cooling about 0.2°C per day through mid-October. That means early-October warmth does not carry over much.
- None of the 11 years came near either end of the question's 5-40°C range.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market for this question or a closely related one.
- I could not retrieve CPC's October 2026 monthly outlook map for New York as issued Sep 17. The only CPC guidance I found is the seasonal "leaning above-normal" for the Northeast in OND (see section 3).
- CPC's week 3-4 outlook would cover early-to-mid October around this date, but I did not retrieve it.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-30: CPC updates its October monthly outlook (last day of the month).
- About 2026-10-01 to 10-05: CPC 8-14 day and week 3-4 outlooks start to cover Oct 13-19. Deterministic models reach the window around Oct 3-6.
- 2026-10-08: CPC ENSO update.
- Tropical systems or strong fronts in mid-October could swing the weekly mean by several degrees.
- About 2026-10-20 to 10-25: ERA5 data for the window appears in the archive, with a delay of a few days.
